One grey morning a green bottle knocked against the rocks below, and he climbed down to fetch it. Inside was a curl of paper, soft with damp, the ink nearly gone. That night he wrote his own letter, folded it small, and sent it out on the next tide, trusting the water to carry it.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯还亮着，光晕落在空荡的马路上，偶尔有洒水车缓缓驶过，留下一道湿痕。便利店的玻璃里透出冷白的光，店员靠在柜台边打盹。远处高楼多半是黑的，只有零星几扇窗还亮着，不知是失眠的人，还是早班的工人。风很轻，带着夜里残留的凉意。这是城市最安静的时刻，白天的喧嚣暂时退场，一切都在等待第一班地铁和第一缕天光的到来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller copy of itself.\n- Like two mirrors facing each other, each step repeats inside the one before it, getting smaller.\n- It stops when the problem is so tiny there's nothing left to split, and then all the pieces come back together."}
